body_style.van: Van body style supported by observed cohort evidence.

size_segment.minicompact: Source-specific minicompact market segment; not an inferred EPA interior-volume class.
size_segment.subcompact: Source-specific subcompact market segment; not an inferred EPA interior-volume class.
size_segment.compact: Source-specific compact market segment; not an inferred EPA interior-volume class.
size_segment.midsize: Source-specific midsize market segment; not an inferred EPA interior-volume class.
size_segment.large: Source-specific large market segment; not an inferred EPA interior-volume class.
size_segment.small_suv: Source-specific small suv market segment; not an inferred EPA interior-volume class.
size_segment.midsize_suv: Source-specific midsize suv market segment; not an inferred EPA interior-volume class.
size_segment.large_suv: Source-specific large suv market segment; not an inferred EPA interior-volume class.
size_segment.small_pickup: Source-specific small pickup market segment; not an inferred EPA interior-volume class.
size_segment.full_size_pickup: Source-specific full size pickup market segment; not an inferred EPA interior-volume class.

market_positioning.economy: Originally positioned for economical entry-level ownership; not low used asking price.
market_positioning.mainstream: Explicitly sourced general-market positioning; never the default for an unknown vehicle.
market_positioning.premium: Explicit premium positioning, retained separately from luxury.
market_positioning.luxury: Model-specific positioning emphasizing luxury, comfort, materials or refinement; not make alone.
market_positioning.ultra_luxury: Explicit ultra-luxury positioning; not inferred from high price.

performance_character.sport_oriented_variant: Explicit model/variant description as sport oriented variant; horsepower or door count alone cannot establish this label.
performance_character.sports_car: Explicit model/variant description as sports car; horsepower or door count alone cannot establish this label.
performance_character.muscle_car: Explicit model/variant description as muscle car; horsepower or door count alone cannot establish this label.
performance_character.grand_tourer: Explicit model/variant description as grand tourer; horsepower or door count alone cannot establish this label.
performance_character.supercar: Explicit model/variant description as supercar; horsepower or door count alone cannot establish this label.
performance_character.hypercar: Explicit model/variant description as hypercar; horsepower or door count alone cannot establish this label.

powertrain.combustion: Supported decoded electrification and fuel evidence for combustion.
powertrain.hybrid: Supported decoded electrification and fuel evidence for hybrid.
powertrain.plug_in_hybrid: Supported decoded electrification and fuel evidence for plug in hybrid.
powertrain.battery_electric: Supported decoded electrification and fuel evidence for battery electric.
powertrain.other: Supported decoded electrification and fuel evidence for other.

hierarchy_policy: Relationships describe vocabulary only. Assignment of an additional label requires evidence; no automatic implication.

compact_executive.evidence: also known as a compact luxury car
